issue_context.title: NativeAOT: Reporting of the exceptions in the event viewer
issue_context.body:
I compile WinForms application and it crashes with "marshalling not supported", this message is only visible in the WinDbg, but not  in the console and not in the EventViewer.

```
Faulting application name: WindowsFormsApp1.exe, version: 1.0.0.0, time stamp: 0x6090d7e5
Faulting module name: WindowsFormsApp1.exe, version: 1.0.0.0, time stamp: 0x6090d7e5
Exception code: 0x4b1b53b5
Fault offset: 0x0000000000bedd88
Faulting process id: 0x38a8
Faulting application start time: 0x01d740a4363a160b
Faulting application path: ...\WindowsFormsApp1.exe
Faulting module path: ...\WindowsFormsApp1.exe
Report Id: e4b0ae11-b78f-48f7-a3e5-1255eb71649d
Faulting package full name: 
Faulting package-relative application ID: 
```

Would be good to have actual error message here as well.
comments:
In general the error message will be printed to stderr, but for a `WinExe` it will be redirected to `NUL` for performance by default. You can overwrite the behavior and print it to a specified file via command line:
```
WindowsFormsApp1.exe 2>err.log
```
@hez2010  This does not works for WinForms application. Or at least this does not works for me. Empty file produced.

@kant2002 I've tested your `CoreRTWinFormsTestBed` and this approach works for me. Did you forget to put a `2` before `>err.log`?

Update: it only works in cmd. It won't work if you're using powershell.
Or you can use `& .\WindowsFormsApp1.exe 2>&1 | Out-String` in powershell.
